requirements.statement: Show every certificate result next to its specification limit, with its result
acceptance: Each parameter row shows the specification, the certificate value and the result
No value has to be re-keyed

requirements.statement: Derive a verdict (ready, hold, escalate) and show how it was derived
acceptance: The verdict names the results that drive it

requirements.statement: Allow release only when every result is within specification
acceptance: Release is disabled with an 'unlocks when' reason otherwise

requirements.statement: Require a rationale of at least 20 characters for hold and reject
acceptance: A shorter rationale is refused with a message, and focus moves to the field

requirements.statement: Escalate lots with a missing or unreadable result to the QA lead, never lowering the tier
acceptance: An unreadable value makes the verdict 'Escalate to QA lead'

requirements.statement: Record every decision with the reviewer, the time, the rationale and the verdict at that moment
acceptance: The decision log lists every decision, newest first

requirements.statement: Draft the supplier notice from the results that need action, and never send it from the tool
acceptance: The draft lists every result that needs action

requirements.statement: Run offline in a browser from one file on the plant tablets
acceptance: Opens from file:// with zero network requests

requirements.statement: Filter the queue by status and search it, with a way back from an empty result

constraints.statement: Decisions must be attributable to a named reviewer with a time
Use the Fabrikam Quality UI guide
